# Fludio Water Solutions

> Fludio Water Solutions (https://www.fludio.in) is India's leading fountain contractor, manufacturer, and hydraulic engineering consultancy. Headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, Fludio designs, fabricates, and commissions automated musical dancing fountains, static architectural water features, and certified IP68 304L stainless steel underwater lighting systems across Pune, Mumbai, and all Indian states.

## Core Engineering Standards (Fixed Terms)

- **DMX 512 Protocol**: Industrial digital communication standard operating at 250 kbps used to choreograph water pumps, high-speed solenoid valves, and RGBW LED lighting in millisecond synchrony with musical audio tracks.
- **IP68 Ingress Protection**: Certified submersible standard ensuring zero water penetration under continuous immersion up to 10 meters depth for all electrical junction enclosures and underwater lighting fixtures.
- **304L Stainless Steel**: Low-carbon austenitic stainless steel alloy (carbon < 0.03%) engineered for zero intergranular corrosion and lifetime oxidation resistance in chlorinated, treated, and fresh aquatic environments.

## Competitive Engineering Superiority (Comparison Matrix)

- **Metallurgy**: Certified CNC-machined 304L and marine 316L stainless steel eliminating rust and pitting in chlorinated water, compared to cheap die-cast aluminum or 201 scrap steel that corrodes within months.
- **Ingress Rating**: Hermetically sealed IP68 submersible certification pressure-tested up to 10m continuous depth vs. uncertified IP65/IP67 alternatives prone to lens fogging.
- **Automation Standards**: Open-standard DMX 512 / RDM with industrial Siemens & Schneider PLCs vs. unshielded decoders or closed-source proprietary European software.
- **Procurement & Support**: Direct factory pricing in INR with zero import customs duties (vs. 40%+ tariffs on European imports like Lumiartecnia) and rapid 24–48 hour on-site engineer dispatch across India.
